# Let's parse the note content to extract songs with TODO
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- " and trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        line_clean = line.strip()
        if line_clean.startswith('- '):
            line_clean = line_clean[2:]
        # Remove " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        line_clean = line_clean.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '')
        # Split on " BY " to get title and artists
        parts = line_clean.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            artists = parts[1].strip()
            songs_todo.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
        else:
            print("Could not parse line:", line)
print("Number of TODO songs:", len(songs_todo))
print(songs_todo)

steps.code:
# Let's fetch release dates for all remaining songs
spotify_token = spotify_login['access_token']
release_dates = {}

for song in songs_todo:
    title = song['title']
    artists = song['artists']
    query = f"{title} {artists}"
    search_result = apis.spotify.search_songs(access_token=spotify_token, query=query)
    # Find matching song
    matched = None
    for item in search_result:
        if item['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check artists match
            item_artists = [a['name'] for a in item['artists']]
            # Check if all expected artists are in item_artists (order may vary)
            expected_artists = [a.strip() for a in artists.split(',')]
            if all(any(ea.lower() == ia.lower() for ia in item_artists) for ea in expected_artists):
                matched = item
                break
    if matched:
        release_date = matched['release_date']
        # Extract month and year
        # release_date format like "2022-12-11T06:22:44"
        year = release_date[:4]
        month = release_date[5:7]
        release_dates[song['line']] = f"{month}/{year}"
        print(f"{title} -> {month}/{year}")
    else:
        print(f"NO MATCH for {title} by {artists}")

print("Done fetching")
